channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: Voting begins for high-stakes bypolls in three States, one U.T. | LIVE
item.description: Polling for the byelection to Assam’s Nagaon Lok Sabha constituency is witnessing a triangular contest among the BJP, Congress and the AIUDF

item.title: DVAC launches probe into the alleged sand mining scam during the DMK government
item.description: A detailed inquiry was ordered on the basis of a complaint filed by the Directorate of Enforcement (ED) which alleged serious irregularities in the mining of river sand across Tamil Nadu

item.title: ECI fact-checks claims on Form 6 following SC observation
item.description: Post-CJI comment, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi targets CEC saying, “It is now established beyond doubt that Gyanesh Kumar changed Form 6 illegally and unilaterally”

item.title: Delhi Govt withholds current duty charge of Additional DCP given to officer accused of sexually harassing journalist
item.description: The proposal to confer additional duty charge to these officers was initiated on August 25, “much before the present set of events”, the government said

item.title: ‘Draft reservation list for polls to rural local bodies ready’
Fire breaks out on reality show set at Goregaon Film City; no injuries reported
item.description: The Mumbai Fire Brigade, local police, BMC Ward Control and a 108 Ambulance team were mobilised, and the blaze was brought under control

item.title: Mayawati reappoints Akash Anand as national convener in BSP
item.description: On September 10, Ms. Mayawati had announced the ouster of her nephew Mr. Anand, setting him “completely free” from BSP

item.title: Shinde meets PM Modi over Maharashtra drought, says Centre assures support for farmers
item.description: The hour-long meeting focused on the situation facing farmers, including water availability, agricultural conditions and the availability of fodder for livestock

item.title: Supreme Court quashes Bombay HC order directing Maharashtra FDA to pay ₹5 lakh compensation
item.description: The case dates back to June 12, when FDA food safety officers in Pune inspected the establishment following a complaint of food poisonining

item.title: First international cargo vessel leaves eastern Assam since 1947
item.description: Once one of India’s busiest river ports, Dibrugarh eyes greater movement of goods

item.title: Set to leave party, NC MP Ruhullah meets students at Kashmir University, calls for ‘restoring students’ voice’
item.description: The rebel NC MP has started an outreach in J&K ahead of the proposed resignation on November 3 this year from the party

item.title: 19,000 West Bengal voters to miss bypolls as appeals remain pending in tribunals
item.description: Out of the 19 Appellate Tribunals set up by the Election Commission in March, only 16 remain functional, as three retired judges — Justice T.S. Sivagnanam, Justice Ranjit Bag and Justice Indrajit Chatterjee — have quit, citing various functional issues. Their positions remain vacant.

item.title: CEC Gyanesh Kumar has lost public trust and must be removed, say former bureaucrats, activists
item.description: Former Home Secretary, Delhi L-T among delegation which sought to serve CEC with a “public impeachment notice”; heavy police barricading prevented the group from reaching the ECI office

item.title: Gyanesh Kumar changed Form 6 ‘illegally’ during SIR, says Rahul Gandhi
item.description: The Opposition party also alleged that the CEC “betrayed” the Constitution in letter and spirit at the behest of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah

item.title: Supreme Court refuses to stay proceedings against Nicobar project
item.description: The petitions in the Calcutta High Court say that the diversion of over 130 sq. km of pristine tropical forest violated the Forest Rights Act and threatened the Shompen and Nicobarese way of life and culture

item.title: Construction of Vaduthala railway overbridge, Perandoor-Vaduthala bridge to begin on October 7
item.description: The new bridge, which is being constructed across the Perandoor Canal and will connect Vaduthala and Perandoor, will serve as a key transport link and enable people to travel quickly from Container Road via Vaduthala to Kaloor, thereby bypassing the congested National Highway

item.title: Pretty in pink, but Malarikkal’s lilies worry ecologists
item.description: A two-year study for the Kerala State Biodiversity Board finds the water lily, which appeared in Malarikkal after the 2018 floods, has shown unprecedented and uncontrolled growth; ecologists flag its impact on local aquatic plants, water flow and sunlight penetration, besides concerns over methane emissions from decaying plant biomass; the seasonal bloom has transformed Malarikkal into a tourism hotspot, bringing additional income to farmers, boat operators and local residents

item.title: Two captive-bred Great Indian Bustards released into wild in Rajasthan under conservation efforts
item.description: Bhupender Yadav said the milestone was the outcome of nearly a decade of unwavering dedication by our scientists, researchers, and ground staff to help the Great Indian Bustard, a critically endangered bird, reclaim the deserts of Rajasthan

item.title: Chief Secy should ask District Collectors to instruct officials to follow Union Govt.’s guidelines on protocols: MP
item.description: Mr. Ravikumar said that an order issued on January 12, 2026, states that MPs representing the area must be invited to public functions organised by a Government office

item.title: Wayanad township: Second-phase house construction to be completed by October 31
item.description: Agriculture Minister T. Siddique said the draw of lots for allotting the houses to the beneficiaries would be held by November 1, 2026.

item.title: Encroachment of land in Mumbai
item.description: Converting public land for private luxury residences prioritises the luxury of a few over the lives of millions

item.title: T.N. allocated ₹812 crore for Annan Seer scheme
item.description: Marriages taking place on or after the date of issue of the government order would be covered under the scheme

item.title: Rawat defies warning by Congress brass, carries on Uttarakhand yatra
West Bengal BLOs write to CEO, seek security ahead of drive to re-enrol voters
Veeramani’s drivers held on charges of abetment
item.description: The police also conducted searches at the residences of the three accused in connection with their alleged role in facilitating Veeramani’s offences

item.title: India-UAE joint military exercise begins in Uttarakhand; focus on mountain warfare
item.description: The exercise, being conducted from October 5-18, aims to enhance inter-operability, mutual understanding and cooperation, with a focus on mountain warfare, it said

item.title: There should be no GST on MDR for UPI transactions: C. Rangarajan
Vijay writes to Centre over arrest of fishermen by Sri Lanka
item.description: He also makes a strong case for reviving the India-Sri Lanka Joint Working Group on Fisheries

item.title: Prisons DIG allegedly sexually exploited convict’s wife
Minister calls for efficient power use
Silver jewellery worth ₹5 lakh stolen from shop
Amal College teacher wins Guinness record
Formal complaint lodged by ERO against applicant for bulk Form-7 applications in Musheerabad
Malappuram to host KSTA State conference in February
Case registered over FB post using Sudhakaran’s name, photo
item.description: The Kannur Cyber Crime Police have registered a case and launched an investigation against the owner of a Facebook account for allegedly circulating a fake post using the photograph and name of Congress leader K. Sudhakaran.

item.title: Animal welfare groups seek clarity over transfer of five Assam elephants to Tamil Nadu
item.description: In a joint representation to the Chief Minister and other authorities, the organisations sought clarity on whether the elephants were gifted, purchased or transferred

item.title: Madurantakam, Dharapuram go to polls for second time in six months
item.description: Over 2.13 lakh voters in Madurantakam and more than 2.23 lakh voters in Dharapuram set to exercise their franchise. The Tamil Nadu government has declared a public holiday in both constituencies on Tuesday on account of the byelections

item.title: Ram Madhav takes part in meeting of BJP functionaries in Chennai
Misuse prompts Keralam Revenue dept. to cancel 2017 circular permitting correction of survey numbers
item.description: Circular had permitted corrections in title deed forms where survey numbers were erroneously entered. Survey numbers were amended in over 600 cases by misusing the circular, according to the Land Revenue Commissioner’s communication to the government sent in August 2026

item.title: ‘Maa Nava Puranam’ book released
Arrested Navy sailor remanded to judicial custody
Admiral Paparo meets top Indian military leadership at U.S. Envoy’s dinner in New Delhi
item.description: The head of the U.S. Indo-Pacific Command is in India to advance U.S.-India major defence partnership and deepen military-to-military cooperation

item.title: In Keralam, ‘affordable’ private health care is easier said than done
item.description: Keralam government’s efforts to draft a new Bill in this regard brings the Kerala Clinical Establishments (Registration and Regulations) Act 2018, back into focus; the private health sector is still holding out against the Act, which aims to bring the entire health sector, public and private, under a regulatory framework

item.title: Rajaka community stages protest in Visakhapatnam seeking SC status
‘Save Guruganga’ campaign reaches Bidar
APCPDCL plans awareness camps on solar power systems from October 6-8
National Conference raises concern over ‘skewed reservation policy’ in J&K
item.description: General category candidates, if we keep increasing reservation, will be pushed to the status of the Scheduled Castes as was in 1947, says Farooq Abdullah

item.title: ‘They think they can beat us into submission,’ Neha Bora says in Kolkata
item.description: Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute, Indian Statistical Institute, and Jadavpur University students join convention to speak out against crackdown on educational institutes, and the voter rights’ issue

item.title: Families of three labourers who died while cleaning septic tank in Ariyalur refuse to accept bodies
item.description: They demand that the State government should provide ₹30 lakh each as compensation for the victims

item.title: Pro-Left Syndicate members to boycott honourary doctorate presentation event in Calicut varsity on October 6
item.description: Film-maker Sathyan Anthikad and industrialist P.K. Ahammed are all set to get Doctor of Letters degree while scientist E.D. Jemmis will be presented with a Doctor of Science degree

item.title: Inadequate hostel facilities continue to haunt medical college students in Kozhikode
item.description: According to functionaries of the students’ union at the college, female students are the worst affected. Though the construction of two new hostel buildings is almost complete, they are yet to be thrown open for stay.

item.title: Congress campaign against vote chori to help re-enroll voters whose names were deleted in SIR
item.description: Congress to invite DMK, AAP to INDIA bloc rally on November 1; ‘Vote bachao, desh bachao’ campaign to start at block level from October 10 to 20, culminate in Delhi Chalo marches, rally in the capital on November 26

item.title: Kozhikode Corporation revises annual Plan; escalator to come up near mofussil bus stand
item.description: The revised Plan follows an additional ₹40.92-crore allocation for spillover projects, while allocations for day-care homes and City of Literature activities have been increased, and ₹45 lakh has been sanctioned for the Samanwaya project

item.title: After SC notice, BJP accuses Rahul Gandhi of ‘spreading lies and confusion’ over Form 6
item.description: At press conference, BJP spokesperson Sambit Patra argues that the Supreme Court had neither called Form 6 illegal nor rejected it; the court’s decision to issue notices to the government and the Election Commission demonstrated a functioning democratic process, he argues

item.title: Andhra Pradesh special TET for in-service teachers from October 11
SEBI to partly reverse derivative settlement rules after pushback, sources say
item.description: SEBI told it had received 20,000 suggestions to tweak the rules in response to a consultation paper issued last month

item.title: 15th Five-Year Plan of Keralam will be a 'living document,' says Planning Board Vice-Chairperson K.M. Chandrasekhar
item.description: The Plan, which will cover the 2027-2032 period, will target a higher growth trajectory for the State and will aim to address critical issues facing the State such as the unemployment rate, he says

item.title: Bombay High Court declines to stay deletion of names from voters’ list in Maharashtra
item.description: The court was hearing a petition that sought safeguards against the exclusion of eligible voters and transparency in the methodology used for the SIR

item.title: ED searches 16 places linked to smuggling of foreign-origin betel nut via the Indo-Myanmar border
item.description: Dried areca nut consignments were brought overland to the Indo-Myanmar border opposite Champhai in Mizoram, and ferried across the Tiau river at Zokhawthar in small lots, bypassing the Land Customs Station, in a well-organised racket, the ED alleges

item.title: Man dies days after alleged police assault in Chirayinkeezhu
